item.text:
**Verdict:** No. Xi’s 2024 record shows some controlled admissions of problems and a few technocratic/anti-favoritism moves, but the stronger pattern is loyalty politics, censorship, punitive enforcement, and official messaging that normalizes denial and information control.

**Positive / weakly yes**
| Title | Publisher / Date | Claim-level summary | Question IDs | URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Xi stresses discipline in Party-wide campaign | `english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua`, `2024-01-10` | Xi said corruption remained serious in finance, SOEs, energy, medicine, and infrastructure, and called for tighter oversight. This is real candor, but it is still framed as Party self-policing rather than ethical transparency. | `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.6` | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202401/10/content_WS659dd697c6d0868f4e8e2e74.html |
| China to defuse risks in real estate, local gov't debt, small and medium-sized financial institutions | `english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua`, `2024-03-05` | The work report openly named real-estate, local-debt, and financial-sector risks before the legislature. That is partial disclosure rather than triumphal denial. | `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.6` | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/05/content_WS65e67f6ec6d0868f4e8e4a72.html |
| China releases action plan to improve government procurement | `english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua`, `2024-07-04` | The plan called for equal treatment across ownership types and anti-bid-rigging enforcement. That is the clearest formal anti-favoritism signal in the 2024 record. | `7B.10`, `7B.9` | https://english.www.gov.cn/policies/latestreleases/202407/04/content_WS66866f3cc6d0868f4e8e8dc1.html |
| China to create sound environment for private business: official | `english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua`, `2024-01-10` | The NDRC said private-enterprise views should inform policy and that officials should protect entrepreneurs’ rights and respond to demands. This is a limited anti-capture signal, though it remains top-down. | `7B.10`, `7B.9` | https://english.news.cn/20240110/78198229d70d4ad2824f8b50c3bedeee/c.html |
| China's central bank reshuffles monetary policy committee | `Reuters`, `2024-03-19` | Adding the CSRC head and two academic economists is a modest technocratic staffing move rather than pure cronyism. Reuters also noted the body’s influence is limited. | `7B.10`, `7B.9` | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/chinas-central-bank-reshuffles-monetary-policy-committee-3345182 |

**Negative / stronger no**
| Title | Publisher / Date | Claim-level summary | Question IDs | URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| China passes law granting Communist Party more control over cabinet | `Reuters`, `2024-03-11` | The revised State Council law gave the Party more executive control over the cabinet, and the premier’s press conference was canceled. That is direct evidence of centralized, politically managed authority rather than ethical institutional restraint. | `7B.10`, `7B.9`, `7B.8`, `7B.6` | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-passes-law-granting-communist-party-more-control-over-cabinet-3331891 |
| China watchdog doubles down on vow to heed Xi's anti-graft drive | `Reuters / MarketScreener`, `2024-01-10` | The anti-graft apparatus said it would catch “corrupt and disloyal” officials. That frames enforcement as loyalty control as much as anti-corruption, which is inconsistent with ethical modeling. | `7B.10`, `7B.9`, `7B.6` | https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-watchdog-doubles-down-on-vow-to-heed-Xi-s-anti-graft-drive-45713924/ |

This is direct evidence of deliberate denial/blame-shifting rather than honest accountability. | `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.7`, `7B.6` | https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjbzhd/202402/t20240219_11246993.html |

| Freedom House: China Freedom in the World 2024 | `Freedom House`, `2024` | Freedom House describes one of the world’s most restrictive media environments, with direct Party control, directives, blocks, app removals, and mass deletions. That is systematic normalization of controlled information. | `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.7`, `7B.6` | https://freedomhouse.org/country/china/freedom-world/2024 |
| Hong Kong's landmark national security trial for 47 democrats | `Reuters`, `2024-05-30` | Long pretrial detention, bail denial, a juryless trial, and mass convictions show the state using law to punish opponents rather than model fair, trust-building conduct. | `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `7B.7`, `7B.6` | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hong-kongs-landmark-national-security-trial-for-47-democrats-3462427 |
| Local favoritism in China's public procurement | `Journal of Urban Economics / ScienceDirect`, `2024` | The study finds strong local favoritism in procurement, including a 39.9% higher win probability for local bidders. That is direct evidence of clientelism/favoritism in practice. | `7B.10`, `7B.9` | https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S009411902400086X |

**Search gap**
- I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Xi personally modeled ethical restraint by recusing himself, exposing his own conflicts, or opening independent scrutiny of self-dealing.
- The best positive evidence is mostly **controlled disclosure** and **top-down anti-corruption/procurement rhetoric**.
- The stronger observed pattern is **loyalty-enforced discipline, censorship, and punitive control of critics and media**.
